_seal.note: This file is structure only. It contains no data, no predictions, and no results. It must never be passed to an adjudicator as if it were a dataset. measurement_points is intentionally empty.

governance_boundary: This scaffold is not a dataset and does not certify external support, consciousness, phenomenality, identity transfer, agency, moral status, or bridge-burden closure. It is a placeholder structure for a future human-collected, preregistered, independently adjudicated external experiment.

_measurement_point_field_specification._doc: Annotation block (valid-JSON, not consumed by the adjudicator). Describes what each future measurement_points[i] field must contain. See EXTERNAL_EMPIRICAL_PROTOCOL_SCAFFOLD_G1.1.md section 1 for units and instruments.
_measurement_point_field_specification.id: string, unique immutable point id (mNNN); frozen numbering scheme; TO_BE_PREREGISTERED
_measurement_point_field_specification.timestamp: integer/epoch; temporal order used for Durbin-Watson; TO_BE_MEASURED at capture, not reorderable
_measurement_point_field_specification.observed_delta: real observable under test (e.g. total-variation distribution shift, dimensionless 0..1); TO_BE_MEASURED
_measurement_point_field_specification.qicn_prediction: a-priori QICN value for observed_delta, frozen before capture, hashed; TO_BE_PREREGISTERED + TO_BE_FROZEN_BEFORE_DATA_COLLECTION
_measurement_point_field_specification.rival_prediction: a-priori non-straw-man rival value (trace-memory Markov suite), frozen same act; TO_BE_PREREGISTERED + TO_BE_FROZEN_BEFORE_DATA_COLLECTION
_measurement_point_field_specification.measurement_sigma: declared instrument measurement-noise std; estimated from instrument physics / technical replicates, NOT fitted to QICN; TO_BE_MEASURED
_measurement_point_field_specification.noise_floor: baseline activity floor of the observable under control/sham; TO_BE_MEASURED
_measurement_point_field_specification.separator_id: preregistered identity-separator targeted at this point; TO_BE_PREREGISTERED
_measurement_point_field_specification._bridge_estimator_columns: if a bridge_certificate is declared, each invariant needs its *_estimate column per point; TO_BE_MEASURED

decision_thresholds._doc: Start from the canonical template values, but they must be re-frozen and EXTERNALLY calibrated (null/rival ensemble not tuned to QICN) before any support inference. See protocol scaffold section 3 and 4.
decision_thresholds._threshold_calibration_status_target: externally_calibrated_holdout (requires the lineage block below to be all-true and adjudicator-signed)

threshold_calibration_lineage._doc: v31 calibration_lineage gate. All three must be true, set by an INDEPENDENT adjudicator, to escape BLOCKED_CIRCULAR_CALIBRATION.

temporal_dependence_policy._doc: Section 5. Prefer independent points so residuals approximate iid. If continuous series, model AR(1)/GLS with preregistered params. Range is a DIAGNOSTIC, not a support pass.

perturbation_type_registry._doc: v31 typed_perturbation_separation gate (BLOCKED_TYPE_CONFUSION). Internal perturbations and external extension witnesses must be declared separately and non-empty. Perturbation source must be INDEPENDENT of the model.

model_parameters._doc: Parameter counts feed the AICc complexity penalty. Keep QICN free-parameter count honest; do not under-count to win AIC.

bridge_certificate._doc: Optional. If included, each latent invariant needs an estimator column per measurement point with a preregistered tolerance vector. Operational coverage only; never a proof of latent preservation, phenomenality, or identity transfer.

claims_under_test._recommended_first_landing: PRED-EXT-01 is the recommended first prediction to land empirically (see protocol scaffold section 2). This does NOT promote it to a result.

_admissibility_checklist_pointer: See EXTERNAL_EMPIRICAL_PROTOCOL_SCAFFOLD_G1.1.md section 6. While any field remains a TO_BE_* placeholder, this manifest is NOT evaluable and yields no external support.
